about_the_game:
In "Kingdom Monarch", you are a monarch and can build the kingdom of your dreams! You need to build city walls, assign jobs to villagers, recruit soldiers, repel hordes of monsters at night, and expand your village during the day.

Game Features:

  • Choose your character, level up by killing enemies, and learn powerful spells to attack your enemies and protect your castle.

  • A complete day-night cycle. At night, when monsters pass through the portal at night, the kingdom will be attacked by a large number of monsters.

  • Assign jobs to the villagers. Only with abundant support can soldiers fight better outside.

  • Build a powerful army and expand the territory.

  • During the day, only a few monsters on this continent can explore it and bring back rare resources and artifacts.
